create_raw_dataset: create a RawDataset to load paired text-graph data from a wikigraphs data directory
build_graph_from_edges: build a Graph object from a list of tab-separated edge strings using Graph.from_edges
create_bow2text_dataset: create a Bow2TextDataset that tokenizes text and graphs into bag-of-words representations for training
create_graph2text_dataset: create a Graph2TextDataset that produces jraph GraphsTuple batches paired with tokenized text sequences
create_text_only_dataset: create a TextOnlyDataset that yields tokenized text batches without any graph structure input
